projectBackground.name: Retail Demand Forecasting Service
projectBackground.context: A demand model works in a notebook but must serve predictions in real time and stay accurate as customer behaviour changes.

manager.name: Eva Jansen
manager.role: Head of ML Platform, Helix Data Labs
manager.note: A model nobody monitors is a liability. Tell me how we know it's still right and how we get back if it isn't.

assignment.title: Ship the model safely
assignment.brief: Reason about skew, latency and drift, choose a rollout strategy and write a short runbook.

tasks.title: Training-Serving Skew
tasks.prompt: Features are computed with different code in training and serving. The main risk is:
options: Training-serving skew causing worse live accuracy
tasks.reasoning: Different code paths produce different feature values, breaking model assumptions.
tasks.tip: Share feature code or use a feature store.
tasks.mistake: Ignoring skew explains 'it worked offline' failures.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Latency Headroom
tasks.prompt: The p95 budget is 200 ms. Feature fetch takes 40 ms, inference 85 ms and post-processing 35 ms. How much headroom remains (ms)?
tasks.reasoning: Add the stages and subtract from the budget.
tasks.mistake: Ignoring stage costs leads to timeouts at peak load.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Drift
tasks.prompt: Customer behaviour changes and input distributions shift. What is this called and what is the response?
options: Data drift; monitor, investigate and retrain if performance degrades
tasks.reasoning: Drift reduces model accuracy over time and needs monitoring.
tasks.tip: Alert on input and output distributions.
tasks.mistake: Treating drift as static noise lets accuracy decay silently.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Safe Rollout
tasks.prompt: How should the new model be released?
options: Canary release to a small traffic share with automatic rollback
tasks.reasoning: Canary limits blast radius and allows comparison with the old model.
tasks.tip: Define success and rollback thresholds before release.
tasks.mistake: Full cutover without a rollback path risks outage.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Promotion Checklist
tasks.prompt: Select what must be true before promoting the model.
tasks.reasoning: Quality, performance and recoverability are the gates.
tasks.mistake: Promoting without a tested rollback is gambling.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

tasks.title: Runbook Note
tasks.prompt: Write a 3-5 sentence runbook note for the on-call engineer if prediction error spikes.
tasks.modelAnswer: If forecast error exceeds the alert threshold for two hours, first check the input data pipeline and feature freshness, then compare against the previous model on the same traffic. If the new model is worse, shift traffic back to the previous version using the release switch and open an incident. Capture drift metrics and examples for the review. Retraining only starts after the root cause is confirmed.
tasks.reasoning: A good runbook gives the first checks, the decision rule and the rollback action.
tasks.mistake: Retraining first wastes time if the cause is a broken pipeline.
tasks.recommendation: Write down your reasoning and the evidence behind it so a reviewer can verify your conclusion quickly.

caseStudy.title: Case Study: The Model That Silently Decayed
caseStudy.background: A pricing model lost accuracy for months after a supplier changed a data feed. No monitoring existed, and margin fell 2 points before anyone noticed.
caseStudy.challenges: Feature distribution changed; no alert fired.
questions: Why did uptime monitoring miss the problem?
caseStudy.solution: Helix added feature and prediction drift monitors with weekly review and automatic rollback criteria.
caseStudy.lessonsLearned: Monitor data and model behaviour, not just servers.
